from pathlib import Path

\\t\"math/big\"
\\t\"os\"
\\t\"text/template\"
)

\\tn, err := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(1_000_000))

'"\\t\\tlog.Fatal(err)

\\t}
}

try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
        f.write(content)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, path)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmp):
        os.unlink(tmp)
